+"""Directed pair margin with a repulsive-only codeword spacing term."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's directed nearest-codeword margin loss.
+
+    Nearest-codeword indices are selected discretely; distances to the selected
+    rows remain differentiable with respect to both representations and codebook.
+    """
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    margin = parameters.get("margin", 0.01)
+    minimum_gap = parameters.get("minimum_gap", 0.05)
+    separation_weight = parameters.get("separation_weight", 0.1)
+    temperature = parameters.get("temperature", 0.1)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.001)
+
+    source_dist = torch.cdist(source, codebook).square()
+    target_dist = torch.cdist(target, codebook).square()
+    source_idx = source_dist.argmin(dim=1)
+    target_idx = target_dist.argmin(dim=1)
+    c_s = codebook[source_idx]
+    c_t = codebook[target_idx]
+    e_s = source_dist.gather(1, source_idx[:, None]).squeeze(1)
+    e_t = target_dist.gather(1, target_idx[:, None]).squeeze(1)
+
+    pair_gap = torch.linalg.vector_norm(c_t - c_s, dim=1)
+    directed_margin = F.softplus((e_t - e_s + margin) / temperature)
+    repulsion = F.softplus((minimum_gap - pair_gap) / temperature)
+    per_pair = weight * (directed_margin + separation_weight * repulsion)
+    mask = mask.to(device=per_pair.device, dtype=per_pair.dtype)
+    return (per_pair * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
